verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: pahilaa gurmukh janam lai bhai vich varatai hoi iaanaa|

en.bdb: Having been born in this world, the gurmukh becoming innocent and ignorant ducts himself in the fear of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh lai gursikh hoi bhai bhagat vich kharaa siaanaa|

en.bdb: Adopting the teaching of the Guru becomes the Sikh of the Guru and sustaining himself in the loving devotion, e leads a pure and intelligent life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਮਾਣ ਮਹਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh sun ma(n)nai samajh maan mahat vich rahai nimaanaa|

en.bdb: After listening to and understanding it, e accepts the teachings of the Guru and even earning the glories continues be humble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਪੂਜਦਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਿਰਾਸ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh gursikh poojadhaa pairee pai rahiraas lubhaanaa|

en.bdb: In accordance with the teachings of the Guru, he worships the e Sikhs and touching their feet and, following their virtus path, he becomes avourite of all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh manahu na visarai chalan jaan jugat mihamaanaa|

en.bdb: Guru's instruction is never forgotten by the Sikh and he having learnt the way of considering himself as a passing guest, spends his life (purposefully) here.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh miThaa bolanaa niv chalanaa gursikh paravaanaa|

en.bdb: The Sikh of the Guru speaks sweetly and accept  humility as the proper way of life.
The Gurmukh, guru-oriented person earns is livelihood by hard labour and shares his victuals with other Sikhs of the um.
